subject.title: Architecture: reduce import coupling in pi-embedded-runner/attempt.ts (50+ imports) and discord monitor (30 imports)

question: Should this issue become the canonical Discord-monitor boundary refactor while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72072 exclusively owns embedded-runner restructuring?
rationale: The current issue spans two ownership domains, and maintainers must choose the permanent tracking and staging boundary before implementation can be safely scoped.

options.title: Narrow To Discord
options.body: Keep this issue open for the Discord preflight/process/provider split and treat the RuntimePlan RFC as canonical for the embedded runner.

options.title: Consolidate Into RFC
options.body: Expand the RuntimePlan RFC to explicitly include the Discord monitor work, preserve this issue's evidence there, and then close this issue as superseded.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Scope
options.body: Retain both domains here, accepting that implementation will require multiple independently reviewed PRs and shared tracking with the RFC.

recommendation.title: Narrow To Discord
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the Discord preflight/process/provider split and treat the RuntimePlan RFC as canonical for the embedded runner.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the active canonical RuntimePlan roadmap and is best positioned to confirm its intended ownership boundary relative to the Discord work.
